key_insight: Omni123 unifies text-to-2D and text-to-3D training so a 3D-native foundation model can be learned with abundant 2D imagery plus limited 3D assets, producing text-driven 3D outputs with stronger geometric consistency than indirect 2D→3D pipelines.
problem_solved: Overcomes the scarcity of high-quality 3D data and the geometric inconsistencies introduced by editing in 2D then lifting to 3D, enabling direct, consistent text-to-3D generation with far fewer 3D examples.
method: Jointly train a single model on both text→2D and text→3D tasks using a shared latent/representation so 2D data can meaningfully inform 3D generation.
Incorporate geometry-aware supervision (multi-view consistency, differentiable rendering or implicit 3D representations) and targeted losses that transfer 2D photometric signals into 3D structure.
Design a 3D-native architecture that leverages limited 3D assets for explicit spatial priors while scaling learning with abundant 2D imagery.
impact: Enables scalable, higher-quality 3D content generation without requiring massive 3D datasets, lowering the barrier for 3D applications in content creation, AR/VR, robotics, and simulation. Practitioners can bootstrap 3D models from existing 2D corpora while preserving geometry.
visual_elements: Pipeline diagram showing joint text→2D and text→3D training with a shared latent space and geometry-aware losses

paper_title: Omni123: Exploring 3D Native Foundation Models with Limited 3D Data by Unifying Text to 2D and 3D Generation
paper_authors: Chongjie Ye, Cheng Cao, Chuanyu Pan, Yiming Hao, Yihao Zhi
